sections.Profile:
"Black Jack" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in 1960. Designed by Harry Mabs, the game features a card-playing theme, specifically focusing on the popular casino game of blackjack. The playfield includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, three kick-out holes, and a gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
